rules: Use PRODUCT.md as the strategic source and DESIGN.md as the visual source.
Keep / as the primary surface; do not rebuild /blog as a primary archive.
Prefer tonal layering and rings before shadows.
Keep feed media real and traceable to content sources.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact primary action using Olive Ink and near-paper text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{height:2rem;padding:0 .625rem;border-radius:.625rem;border:1px solid transparent;background:oklch(0.228 0.013 107.4);color:oklch(0.988 0.003 106.5);font:500 .875rem/1 Instrument Sans,system-ui,sans-serif;transition:background-color 150ms ease,transform 150ms ease}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid oklch(0.737 0.021 106.9);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Overview Filter Chip
components.description: URL-backed feed filter with transparent default state and inverted active state.

components.name: Feed Card
components.description: Flat content module with ring separation, real media, and compact metadata.
components.css: .ds-feed-card{overflow:hidden;border-radius:.875rem;background:oklch(1 0 0);color:oklch(0.153 0.006 107.1);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab,oklch(0.153 0.006 107.1) 10%,transparent)}.ds-feed-media{aspect-ratio:16/10;background:oklch(0.966 0.005 106.5)}.ds-feed-body{display:grid;gap:.75rem;padding:1.25rem}.ds-feed-badge{justify-self:start;border:1px solid oklch(0.93 0.007 106.5);border-radius:999px;padding:.125rem .5rem;font:500 .75rem/1 Instrument Sans,system-ui,sans-serif}

components.name: Article Hero
components.description: Image-led detail hero with a dark overlay and large serif headline.
